findings.evidence: Basic.lean:52-54 `def Q2 (g) (K) : ℝ := - g K.q K.q`; Basic.lean:45 `hq : q = k - kPrime`; AccessMethods.lean:130-132; roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/RadiativeCorrections/README.md:500 "**Definition** (`sigmaMethod`). `Q²` from the electron method and, writing `q_h = p_X - P`, `y_Σ = (P·q_h)/((P·q_h) + (P·k'))`".
findings.fix: Delete `q2Sigma` and `q2Sigma_eq_Q2`, and drop the now-unused `kIn` field of `SigmaMethodData`. A consumer holding lepton momenta uses `DisKinematics.Q2 g K` directly; for the Sigma method proper, take Q² from `ElectronMethodData.q2Electron` as the roadmap specifies.
findings.issue: `q2Sigma d g_met = -g_met (d.kIn - d.kOut) (d.kIn - d.kOut)` is `DisKinematics.Q2` (Basic.lean:52, `Q2 g K = - g K.q K.q` with `K.hq : q = k - kPrime`) restated on a renamed carrier; `q2Sigma_eq_Q2` (line 130) proves exactly that by `rw [q2Sigma, DisKinematics.Q2, K.hq, hk, hk']`, with no hypotheses. The module header (line 16) states it outright: "the Sigma Q² is the canonical `DisKinematics.Q2`". It is also not the Sigma method: the roadmap defines Q²_Σ as the electron-method Q².

findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:146-169; `grep -r 'q2ESigma\|yESigma\|ESigmaMethodData' EpsilonEridani/` matches only this file; roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/RadiativeCorrections/README.md:501 gives `x_Σ = Q²_e/(2 (P·k) y_Σ)`.
findings.fix: Delete `q2ESigma`, `yESigma` and `q2ESigma_pos` (and `ESigmaMethodData`, which then carries nothing): callers use `ElectronMethodData.q2Electron`, `SigmaMethodData.ySigma` and `ElectronMethodData.q2Electron_pos` directly. If an eSigma record is wanted, give it the one quantity that is genuinely new, the roadmap's `x_Σ = Q²_e / (2 (P·k) y_Σ)`, which neither component provides.
findings.issue: With the averaging removed, the whole eSigma block is thin wrappers over located declarations: `ESigmaMethodData` (147) is the bare product `ElectronMethodData × SigmaMethodData` with no relational field; `q2ESigma d = ElectronMethodData.q2Electron d.electronData` (158); `yESigma g d = d.sigmaData.ySigma g` (162); `q2ESigma_pos` (167) restates `q2Electron_pos` (74) and is proved by `rw [q2ESigma]; exact ElectronMethodData.q2Electron_pos _`. Nothing in the repo consumes any of them.

summary: Two duplications introduced by this PR's AccessMethods rewrite: q2Sigma is DisKinematics.Q2 restated on a renamed record (the PR proves this itself in q2Sigma_eq_Q2), and the eSigma layer is now pure aliasing of q2Electron/ySigma with no content of its own. The rest of the diff (lint renames, γ_zero…γ_three, the *_reducedMaster projection lemmas) adds no duplication.
